description: This file defines a PHP class `Poisson` implementing functions for the Poisson distribution calculations, including probability density function (PDF) and cumulative distribution function (CDF). It provides methods to evaluate statistical distributions based on input parameters, with support for array inputs.

classes.name: Poisson
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate Poisson distribution probabilities and cumulative distributions, supporting array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the Poisson distribution probability or cumulative probability for given values and mean; supports array inputs and validation.
